notes.title: Zodiac Revenger steam next fest demo playthrough
notes.notes:
Zodiac Revenger is an action 2D platformer. Follow the Cat as he seeks vengeance on the nasty Rat, who caused him to lose the Zodiac race. And sweep away any other Zodiac that gets in his way.

This is just demo version so thing maybe a bit different when it release.

DON'T FORGET TO WISHLIST THE GAME IF YOU FIND IT INTERESTING.

notes.title: Zodiac Revenger: Steam page launch
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

The store page along with the trailer for my game Zodiac Revenge has finally go live on steam. The game is a 2D action platformer take inspiration from Mega Man Zero series.

If the game somewhat interesting to you, please consider wishlist it to receive the latest update.
